name: iorg
description: Emacs Org mode support for VSCode with service hooks

org.todoKeywords.description: Specifies the types of TODO statuses available (for switching).

org.doneKeywords.description: Specifies the types of DONE statuses available (for switching).

org.underlineTopHeading.description: Top level headings get an underline.

org.todoConfigs.description: Defines TODO list views you would like to query from the orgs server and how to display them

org.bullets.description: Bullets to use in pretty formatting of headings.

org.headingFormatting.description: Styles setting per heading level, up to 8

org.tagOffset.description: How far (characters) out should tags be indented on a headline?

org.captureTemplates.description: Capture templates to use for capture types.

org.linkColoring.description: What color should links be colored when prettied up?

org.updateInterval.description: Interval to update a buffers parsing.

org.decorateLinks.description: Should links be collapsed to pretty format?

org.addLeftZero.description: Add left zero to single-digit dates and months.

org.clockInOutSeparator.description: Clock in and clock out separator

org.allowSelfSigned.description: Allow self signed https certificates on your org server, this is NOT safe

org.worgUrl.description: Where the worg views are loaded from. Empty uses org.orgsConnection. Use the server's http address if its https certificate is self-signed - a webview will not load it.

org.agendaView.description: Which agenda Org: Show Agenda opens: worg's, or the older built-in one.

org.serverPathMap.description: When the orgs server is on another machine: server path prefix -> local path prefix, used to open headings clicked in a worg view.

org.selectedCellIndicator.description: The indicator box to use when moving around within a table

org.targetCellIndicator.description: The indicator box to use when moving around within a table

org.activeFormulaIndicator.description: The indicator box to use when moving around within a table

org.highlight.description: List of regex based decorators can be useful for adding visual interest to your docs

enumDescriptions: Recalculate when leaving a row marked with # in the first column, as org does
Recalculate whenever Tab or Enter leaves a cell of a table with formulas
org.tableAutoRecalc.description: When moving about a table recalculates it. Needs the orgs server and a login.

org.tableRecalcOnSave.description: Recalculate every table with formulas when an org file is saved. Needs the orgs server and a login.

org.blockCodeLens.description: Show Run above source blocks and #+CALL: lines, Update above dynamic blocks, and Recalculate on #+TBLFM: lines.

org.agendaDays.description: How many days, from today, the Agenda in the side bar shows.

org.autoStatistics.description: Keep [2/5] and [40%] statistics cookies on headings up to date as keywords and checkboxes change.

org.pomodoroClocks.description: A timer started under a heading clocks in on it, and out again when it ends.
